headline: RADISSON DRILLS O'BRIEN'S HIGHEST-EVER ASSAY: 1,604 G/T AU OVER 1M WITHIN 316 G/T OVER 5.1M, ABITIBI (TSXV:RDS)
source_name: JCN Newswire / Radisson Mining Resources Inc. (TSXV:RDS)
snippet: Radisson Mining Resources (TSXV:RDS) announced July 7 the highest assay result in O'Brien Gold Project history — hole OB-26-385W4 returned 1,603.95 g/t Au over 1.0 metre within 316.31 g/t Au over 5.1 metres targeting the deep vein extension beneath the former mine workings in Quebec's Abitibi, part of the ongoing 140,000-metre step-out program. The 1.60 kg/t gold core confirms that near-mine high grades persist and are accessible at depth — a critical milestone for a project where grade is the primary feasibility driver.

headline: MARIMACA EXTENDS BORNITE 300M SOUTH AT PAMPA MEDINA — 6M OF 6.11% CU, 40M OF 2.04% CU IN CHILE (TSX:MARI)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Marimaca Copper Corp. (TSX:MARI)
snippet: Marimaca Copper (TSX:MARI) reported July 7 that step-out hole SPRD-07 extended the ultra-high-grade bornite zone at Pampa Medina, Chile 300 metres south of previous drilling — returning 6m at 6.11% Cu and 24.0 g/t Ag within 20m at 2.65% Cu, plus a 40m interval at 2.04% Cu and 11.1 g/t Ag. The 300-metre lateral extension materially expands the Pampa Medina footprint at a moment when US tariffs are intensifying the strategic premium on high-grade copper discoveries outside existing supply chains.

headline: SILVERCO HITS 1,100 G/T AG OVER 10.3M AT CUSI UNDERGROUND — PROMONTORIO ZONE IN 30,000M MEXICO CAMPAIGN (TSXV:SICO)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Silverco Mining Ltd. (TSXV:SICO)
snippet: Silverco Mining (TSXV:SICO) released July 7 underground assay results from the Promontorio zone at its 100%-owned Cusi Property in Chihuahua, Mexico — the first of three planned mining zones — including 1,100 g/t Ag over 10.3 metres from the company's 2026 30,000-metre drill program. Cusi already has a 1,200 tonne-per-day mill on site, making it one of the few TSXV silver explorers with production infrastructure in place to capture the $62/oz silver price environment.

headline: PITCHBLENDE CONFIRMED, TWO RADIOACTIVE TRENDS MAPPED — F4 URANIUM WRAPS MURPHY LAKE, 5KM FROM WORLD'S HIGHEST-GRADE HURRICANE (TSXV:FFU)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / F4 Uranium Corp. (TSXV:FFU) & UraniumX Discovery Corp. (CSE:STMN)
snippet: F4 Uranium Corp. (TSXV:FFU) and UraniumX Discovery Corp. (CSE:STMN) completed their 4,092-metre, nine-hole Murphy Lake program in Saskatchewan's Athabasca Basin on July 7 — five of six target areas returned anomalous radioactivity, pitchblende was visually identified in ML26-015, and two prospective mineralized corridors are now defined for follow-up drilling. Murphy Lake sits 5 km south of IsoEnergy's Hurricane Deposit (world's highest-grade uranium), and the two-corridor result positions the JV with a drill-ready target package for its next campaign.

headline: GOLDGROUP WINS FINAL COURT ORDER — DON DAVID GOLD MINE + CERRO PRIETO MEXICO MERGER CLOSING JULY 17 (OTC:GGAZF / NYSE:GORO)
source_name: Investing News Network / Goldgroup Mining Inc.
snippet: The BC Supreme Court granted the final order approving the Goldgroup Mining and Gold Resource Corporation plan of arrangement on July 7, clearing the last legal hurdle for a combination joining Goldgroup's Cerro Prieto heap-leach mine in Sonora with Gold Resource's Don David Gold Mine in Oaxaca — both Mexico — closing on or about July 17. Both shareholder votes passed with near-unanimous approval (99.99% at Goldgroup), creating a multi-mine Mexican precious metals producer at $4,100+ gold.

headline: NEVADA KING EAST RIDGE DROPS 4.68 G/T AU OVER 7.3M OXIDE — ATLANTA MINE NEAR-SURFACE GOLD OPEN AT DEPTH (TSXV:NKG)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Nevada King Gold Corp. (TSXV:NKG)
snippet: Nevada King Gold (TSXV:NKG) reported July 7 new high-grade oxide gold at the East Ridge Target at Atlanta Gold Mine in Nevada — RAB hole AT26ERB-16 returned 4.68 g/t Au over 7.3m from 21.9m depth (bottomed in mineralization), and AT26ERB-42 returned 1.00 g/t Au over 26.8m from near surface, also open at depth. The East Ridge mineralization shares the same geological style as the existing Atlanta pit resource, with follow-up drilling planned once BLM approves Nevada King's fifth Plan of Operations modification.

headline: SPARTAN METALS SAMPLES 8.48% WO3 AT REES MINE — CRITICAL TUNGSTEN DRILLING STARTS MID-JULY IN NEVADA (TSXV:W)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Spartan Metals Corp. (TSXV:W)
snippet: Spartan Metals Corp. (TSXV:W) released July 7 sampling from the Rees Mine at its Eagle Project in Nevada's Kern Mountains, returning 6.76% and 8.48% WO3 — substantially above the 0.3-1.4% WO3 typical of economically viable tungsten skarns — ahead of a 3,000-metre diamond drill program starting mid-July. Tungsten is on the US critical minerals list and subject to Chinese export restrictions, giving Eagle dual geopolitical relevance as a high-grade domestic source at a time when Western governments are actively building non-Chinese critical mineral supply.

headline: K2 GOLD FIRES 14,000M AT MOJAVE DRAGONFLY — TESTING 45.72M OF 6.68 G/T FROM 2020 WITH 574.5M IN AND 4TH HOLE RUNNING (TSXV:KTO)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / K2 Gold Corp. (TSXV:KTO)
snippet: K2 Gold (TSXV:KTO) updated July 7 its 14,000-metre reverse circulation program at the Mojave Project in California's Inyo County — 574.5 metres across three holes completed at the Dragonfly Target with the fourth hole underway, following up 2020 results of 45.72m at 6.68 g/t Au and 30.48m at 7.18 g/t Au, both starting at surface. No assays have been released yet; the RC format delivers fast turnaround, making initial drill results the next near-term catalyst for this permitted, fully funded California gold program.

headline: STAR COPPER ADDS 2ND RIG TO BC GOLDEN TRIANGLE PORPHYRY — 269M HISTORIC HYPOGENE SYSTEM TESTED IN NORTHEAST EXTENSION (CSE:STCU)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Star Copper Corp. (CSE:STCU)
snippet: Star Copper Corp. (CSE:STCU) mobilized a second drill rig July 7 at the Star Copper-Gold Porphyry Project in BC's Golden Triangle, with the 15,000-metre program now testing a northeastern extension of the Star Main hypogene system where historic hole S-025 returned 269 metres at 0.42% Cu and 0.198 g/t Au. A second rig addition in one of the world's most prolific porphyry camps signals internal geological confidence that the northeast extension carries the same grade continuity as the historically drilled Star Main core.

headline: WILL JULY 2026 BE GOLD AND SILVER'S MONTH OF LIBERATION? GOLDSEEK ON MONETARY METALS AT THE SEMIQUINCENTENNIAL
snippet: A GoldSeek editorial published in early July 2026 asks whether the 250th anniversary month of the United States will mark gold and silver's 'month of liberation' — the point at which the monetary metals begin to fully reflect fiat currency debasement — citing the structural West-to-East capital shift, 20+ consecutive months of central bank buying, and the breakdown of US foreign policy consensus that historically supported gold price management. The piece argues that July 2026's macro configuration mirrors conditions that have preceded decisive breakouts from multi-month precious metals consolidations.

headline: HM EXPLORATION'S BLIND SULPHIDE DISCOVERY EXTENDS LEWIS PILLEY'S LOWER ZONE TO 40M STRIKE ON HOLES 9 AND 10 (CSE:HM)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / HM Exploration Inc. (CSE:HM)
snippet: HM Exploration Inc. (CSE:HM) announced July 7 that drill holes nine and ten at the Lewis Pilley's Project intersected a new blind massive sulphide lens, extending the lower-zone strike length to approximately 40 metres northwest of previous mineralization and confirming the system is expanding. A blind sulphide discovery — invisible at surface and only detectable through drilling — at a new structural position confirms that Lewis Pilley's hosts multiple independent sulphide-bearing lenses, each with separate resource potential.
